description: Java class 'AndroidRootComponent' extending JComponent, responsible for rendering and interacting with Android layout previews within the IDE, including rendering logic, scaling, and launching layout editors.

classes.name: AndroidRootComponent
classes.description: A Swing component for rendering Android layout previews, handling rendering, scaling, and user interactions within the IDE.

methods.name: launchLayoutEditor
methods.description: Opens the associated layout file in the Android layout editor.

methods.name: setRenderResult
methods.description: Sets the current RenderResult and triggers repainting.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the current scale factor for rendering.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Sets the scale factor for rendering.

methods.name: createTransform
methods.description: Creates a Transform object for coordinate conversions, with special handling if the component is a menu.

methods.name: findMenu
methods.description: Recursively searches for a menu view within a list of RenderedView objects.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Retrieves the menu view from the RenderResult hierarchy.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the dimensions of a RenderedView or default size if null.

methods.name: getPreferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size of the component based on current rendering and scale.

methods.name: getScaledImage
methods.description: Returns a scaled version of the rendered image, scaling if necessary.

methods.name: center
methods.description: Draws a centered message string within the component.

methods.name: paintComponent
methods.description: Custom painting logic: draws the scaled image or placeholder message.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Performs asynchronous rendering of the layout using RenderService.

methods.name: getRootView
methods.description: Returns the root RenderedView of the current render result.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Static helper to get the root RenderedView from RenderResult.

methods.name: getRenderedView
methods.description: Returns the leaf RenderedView at a given point.
